name: kankaku-monorepo
description: kankaku client monorepo: the pi extension/library, the Claude Code plugin, and the terminal dashboard, released in lockstep.

scripts.build: npm run build -w kankaku && npm run build -w kankaku-claude && npm run build -w kankaku-tui
scripts.check: npm run build -w kankaku && npm run check -w kankaku && npm run check -w kankaku-claude && npm run check -w kankaku-tui
scripts.publish:all: npm publish -w kankaku && npm publish -w kankaku-claude && npm publish -w kankaku-tui
